title: Position of adjectives
summary: Позиция прилагательных: только перед существительным, только после глагола, после существительного (something strange), смена значения и порядок нескольких прилагательных.
ru:
## Две позиции прилагательного
Прилагательное стоит либо **перед существительным** (*a tall man*, атрибутивная позиция), либо **после глагола-связки** (*The man is tall*, предикативная позиция). Большинство прилагательных свободно используются в обеих позициях, но есть группы, у которых место жёстко закреплено, а у некоторых от позиции меняется значение.

## Только перед существительным
Такие слова ограничивают или выделяют существительное и не могут стоять после *be*: **main, chief, principal, sole, mere, utter, sheer, former, latter, elder, eldest, upper, inner, outer, lone, only, outright, indoor, outdoor, occasional**.
> The **main** reason for the delay was the weather. — Главная причина...
> She is a **mere** child. — Она всего лишь ребёнок.
> My **elder** brother is a lawyer. — Мой старший брат...
- ~~The reason is main.~~ → The **main** reason is the weather.
- ~~Her brother is elder.~~ → Her brother is **older**. / her **elder** brother

## Только после глагола (a-прилагательные и самочувствие)
**afraid, alone, alike, alive, asleep, awake, aware, ashamed, content, glad, ill, ready, sorry, sure, unwell, well.** Перед существительным вместо них берут синонимы.
| После глагола | Перед существительным |
|---|---|
| The baby is **asleep**. | the **sleeping** baby |
| The child is **afraid**. | a **frightened** child |
| It is **alive**. | a **living** creature |
| He is **glad**. | a **happy** man |
| She is **ill**. | a **sick** woman |
Исключение — усиление: *a wide-awake child, a fast-asleep baby* (с наречием через дефис).

## После существительного
Прилагательное идёт **после** существительного:
- с **-body / -one / -thing / -where**: *something strange, anyone interesting, somewhere quiet, nothing new*;
- с прилагательными на **-able / -ible** при превосходной степени или *only / every*: *the best seat available, the only solution possible, every means imaginable*;
- в устойчивых названиях: *attorney general, heir apparent, president elect, court martial*;
- когда прилагательное имеет свою зависимую часть: *a woman fond of animals, people eager to learn, a house ready for sale*.

## Значение зависит от позиции
| Перед сущ. | После сущ. |
|---|---|
| the **present** situation (нынешняя) | the people **present** (присутствующие) |
| a **concerned** parent (встревоженный) | the people **concerned** (те, кого это касается) |
| a **responsible** person (надёжный) | the person **responsible** (виновный / ответственный за это) |
| the **late** president (покойный) | the president was **late** (опоздал) |
| a **certain** person (некий) | I'm **certain** (уверен) |
| an **involved** story (запутанная) | the people **involved** (участвующие) |

## Порядок нескольких прилагательных
Типичный порядок: **мнение → размер → возраст / форма → цвет → происхождение → материал → назначение → существительное.**
> a **lovely small old** stone cottage
> a **long black** silk dress
> a **charming little French** fishing village
Между прилагательными одной группы ставятся запятые или *and*: *a tall, dark, handsome man; a red and white flag.* После глагола-связки перечисление: *The room was large, bright and airy.*
В русском порядок свободнее. Не переносите его: ~~a French beautiful actress~~ → **a beautiful French actress**; ~~a wooden old table~~ → **an old wooden table**.
en:
## Two positions
An adjective goes either **before a noun** (*a tall man*, attributive) or **after a linking verb** (*The man is tall*, predicative). Most adjectives work in both positions, but some groups have a fixed position, and for others the meaning changes with position.

## Only before a noun
These words limit or single out the noun and cannot follow *be*: **main, chief, principal, sole, mere, utter, sheer, former, latter, elder, eldest, upper, inner, outer, lone, only, outright, indoor, outdoor, occasional**.
> The **main** reason for the delay was the weather.
> She is a **mere** child.
> My **elder** brother is a lawyer.
- ~~The reason is main.~~ → The **main** reason is the weather.
- ~~Her brother is elder.~~ → Her brother is **older**.

## Only after a verb (a- adjectives and health)
**afraid, alone, alike, alive, asleep, awake, aware, ashamed, content, glad, ill, ready, sorry, sure, unwell, well.** Before a noun we use synonyms.
| After a verb | Before a noun |
|---|---|
| The baby is **asleep**. | the **sleeping** baby |
| The child is **afraid**. | a **frightened** child |
| It is **alive**. | a **living** creature |
| He is **glad**. | a **happy** man |
| She is **ill**. | a **sick** woman |
With an adverb they can precede a noun: *a wide-awake child, a fast-asleep baby*.

## After the noun
Adjectives come **after** the noun:
- with **-body / -one / -thing / -where**: *something strange, anyone interesting, somewhere quiet, nothing new*;
- with **-able / -ible** adjectives after a superlative or *only / every*: *the best seat available, the only solution possible, every means imaginable*;
- in fixed titles: *attorney general, heir apparent, president elect, court martial*;
- when the adjective has its own complement: *a woman fond of animals, people eager to learn, a house ready for sale*.

## Meaning depends on position
| Before the noun | After the noun |
|---|---|
| the **present** situation (current) | the people **present** (there) |
| a **concerned** parent (worried) | the people **concerned** (affected) |
| a **responsible** person (reliable) | the person **responsible** (to blame / in charge) |
| the **late** president (dead) | the president was **late** (not on time) |
| a **certain** person (some) | I'm **certain** (sure) |
| an **involved** story (complicated) | the people **involved** (taking part) |

## Order of several adjectives
Typical order: **opinion → size → age / shape → colour → origin → material → purpose → noun.**
> a **lovely small old** stone cottage
> a **long black** silk dress
> a **charming little French** fishing village
Use commas or *and* between adjectives of the same group: *a tall, dark, handsome man; a red and white flag.* After a linking verb: *The room was large, bright and airy.*
- ~~a French beautiful actress~~ → **a beautiful French actress**; ~~a wooden old table~~ → **an old wooden table**.
structure:
## Позиции
| Тип | Слова | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| только перед сущ. | main, chief, sole, mere, utter, sheer, former, latter, elder, lone, outright | the main reason |
| только после глагола | afraid, alone, alive, asleep, awake, aware, glad, ill, ready, sorry, sure | The baby is asleep. |
| после сущ. | -body / -one / -thing / -where, -able / -ible | something strange |
| значение меняется | present, concerned, responsible, involved, late, certain | the people concerned |

## Порядок прилагательных
| 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| мнение | размер | возраст / форма | цвет | происхождение | материал | назначение |
| lovely | small | old | red | Italian | leather | sports |

## Формулы
> **a / an + opinion + size + age + colour + origin + material + noun**
> a lovely small old red Italian leather bag
> **-thing / -one + adjective**: something new · anyone suitable
> **superlative + noun + -able / -ible**: the best option available

exercises.title: Порядок прилагательных
exercises.instruction: Вставьте прилагательные из скобок в правильном порядке.

items.text: She bought a {{beautiful old}} vase at the market. (old / beautiful)
He was wearing a {{long black}} coat. (black / long)
We stayed in a {{small modern}} hotel near the station. (modern / small)
It's a {{delicious traditional Italian}} dish. (Italian / delicious / traditional)
They live in a {{huge old stone}} house. (stone / huge / old)
We saw a {{wonderful old French}} film. (French / old / wonderful)
He drives a {{fast red}} sports car. (red / fast)

exercises.title: Позиция и значение
exercises.instruction: Вставьте слово, которое подходит по смыслу (в скобках — подсказка).

items.text: She tried to comfort the {{frightened}} child. (afraid / frightened)
Is there anything {{interesting}} on TV tonight? (interest)
Everyone {{present}} voted in favour of the plan. (присутствующий)
He is a {{living}} legend in the music world. (alive / living)
He was a {{mere}} child when he lost his parents. (всего лишь)

items.q: The baby ___ was in the cot.
items.why: Перед существительным нужно причастие **sleeping**; *asleep* — только после глагола.
Порядок: размер → возраст → материал: **small old stone**.

items.q: He is the ___ president of the club; he left office last year.
The people ___ were all given compensation.
items.why: После существительного: **the people concerned** = «те, кого это коснулось».

items.q: She is a very ___ employee: she never misses a deadline.
A ___ person from the bank called you this morning.
items.why: **a certain person** = «некий человек»; *sure* — только после глагола.

items.q: Какое из слов НЕ может стоять перед существительным?

exercises.title: Составьте фразу
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложение, расставив прилагательные в правильном порядке.

items.prompt: She carried a bag. (big / leather / brown)
answers: She carried a big brown leather bag.

items.prompt: He lives in a house. (old / stone / lovely)
answers: He lives in a lovely old stone house.

items.prompt: They bought a table. (round / wooden / small)
answers: They bought a small round wooden table.

items.prompt: We saw a film. (French / wonderful / old)
answers: We saw a wonderful old French film.
I'd like something hot to drink.
I would like something hot to drink.

items.prompt: Don't wake the baby who is asleep. Используйте sleeping.
answers: Don't wake the sleeping baby.
Do not wake the sleeping baby.

exercises.title: Переведите на английский
exercises.instruction: Переведите на английский. Ключевые слова даны.

answers: The main reason is cost.
The main reason is the cost.
The main reason is price.
The main reason is the price.

items.prompt: Он живёт в красивом старом каменном доме. (stone)
answers: He lives in a beautiful old stone house.
He lives in a lovely old stone house.
He lives in a nice old stone house.

items.prompt: Есть что-нибудь интересное в этой газете? (anything)
answers: Is there anything interesting in this newspaper?
Is there anything interesting in this paper?
Everyone present voted in favour.
Everyone present voted in favor.
All those present voted in favour.
All those present voted in favor.
Everybody present voted in favour.
Everybody present voted in favor.
Don't wake the sleeping baby.
Don't wake the sleeping child.
Do not wake the sleeping baby.
Do not wake the sleeping child.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Опишите предметы, используя несколько прилагательных в правильном порядке. Образцы — для самопроверки.

items.sample: I have a big black leather backpack.

items.prompt: Опишите дом или квартиру вашей мечты.
items.sample: I dream of a spacious modern glass house by the sea.

items.prompt: Назовите что-нибудь интересное, что вы недавно видели или читали (something + adjective).
items.sample: I recently read something fascinating about space travel.

items.prompt: Опишите вашего друга или члена семьи. (an old friend)
items.sample: An old friend of mine is a tall, quiet man with a great sense of humour.

items.prompt: Напишите, кто из людей, участвующих в вашей работе / учёбе, больше всего помогает (the people involved).
items.sample: The people involved in our project have been very supportive.
